alate: Body of the alate deep brown, wing membrane greyish white. Head capsule nearly circular, the epicranial suture faintly visible, with a V-shaped raised line in front of the fontanelle. Long diameter of the compound eye about 3–4 times the distance from it to the lower margin of the head. Long diameter of the ocellus about 2–3 times the ocellus–compound eye distance, and the distance from the ocellus to the antennal socket about twice that from the compound eye to the antennal socket. Antennae 17 segments. Lacinia of the maxilla with eleven marginal hairs. The Cu vein of the forewing and hindwing with about 16 branches.
biology: Specimens collected from a tree known locally as yuchimu.
soldier: Head of the soldier brown with a reddish tinge, pronotum brown, abdomen pale brownish yellow, pilosity of the head capsule rather abundant. Head capsule rectangular, the fontanelle rather projecting, the compound eyes slightly projecting, labrum semicircular. Apex of the mandibles rather curved and slightly upturned. Lacinia of the maxilla with eleven marginal hairs. Antennae 13–14 segments, the first slightly larger than the third, the third about three times the second. Anterior margin of the pronotum with a broad V-shaped incision, the lateral margins gently inclined posteriorly, the middle of the posterior margin slightly concave, the median longitudinal line visible, median emargination index 12–19%, the middle region rather densely hairy.
